paragraphs.text: The Stone Brain was a living artifact created by the Sages of Lat-Nam in the hope of stopping the Brothers' War on Dominaria . The Brain had the power to compel a wizard to obey another, give, or take away the ability to manipulate mana, and is considered one of the most powerful artifacts in Dominarian history.

The Stone Brain was a powerful artifact capable of compelling one wizard to obey another, taking away a wizard's magic, or enabling anyone to manipulate mana. Chaney considered it the most powerful artifact in Dominarian history. Because the wizard Towser erroneously identified it as a mana vault, it initially disguised itself as one, appearing as a simple pink box. After Chaney revealed its deception, it became brainlike, turning green with brown spots, and grew three eyestalks and a mouth. Sprouting a half dozen thick, green tentacles, it was able to walk. As Greensleeves 's students of magic studied it further, it eventually settled into its true form: a round helmet, wrinkled on top like a brain.

The Stone Brain was constructed by the sages at the College of Lat-Nam . It held the power to compel one wizard to obey another, although it is unclear if it was intended to bind and punish wizards or to consolidate the sages' power. Created by the combined efforts of all of the sages, they fought over who should possess it. One of them stole it and ran off into the desert to be eaten by vultures. Considering it too powerful to be destroyed, the sages enclosed it in a box and launched it into space.

Four thousand years later, Gull and Greensleeves saw the artifact as a falling star descending upon the Whispering Woods . Two months later, the wizard Towser retrieved it with their help, believing it to be a mana vault. After he tried to absorb Greensleeves' power with it, they ended up fighting each other.

Thanks to an incident with Tybalt , a student of magic, it was revealed to Gull and Greensleeves how the Stone Brain, which had taken the form of a helmet, worked: once worn, a thousand voices of the Sages of Lat-Nam order the wizard to stop using magic, or face madness. Within the artifact are also hidden all the spells known by the Sages. A test was conducted on Haakon , and he became a sort of slave to Greensleeves, just like the creatures summoned by other wizards. Gull confronted Greensleeves about using the Stone Brain, but she was convinced this was the only way to stop the evil wizards.

Haakon managed to free himself from the Stone Brain command just enough to summon some Phyrexian Gremlins , who snatched the artifact and returned to their home plane . After Greensleeves planeswalked to the Stone Brain, she found out that she could resist the voices, as they were similar to the effect of the Whispering Woods.

Returning to the Whispering Woods, they found that Dacian , the wizard who once battled with Towser over White Ridge , was at the site of the crater where the Stone Brain had fallen from the sky. The army captured Dacian and put the helmet on the wizard. Greensleeves resolved to let Dacian and Haakon go. Unbeknownst to Greensleeves, those tagged by the brain could contact one another, so Dacian and Haakon formed a truce and sought out the other wizards Karli and Towser to form an alliance and stop Gull and Greensleeves's crusade.

When Greensleeves finally understood that the evil wizards had found one another thanks to the Stone Brain, she intended to discover every secret of the artifact. She donned the helmet and found out that its ultimate secret was buried somewhere in the ruins of the College of Lat-Nam , in the long-lost isle of Lat-Nam .

On Lat-Nam, the party discovered a skull of a Sage, which she asked the secret of the Stone Brain. Using the secret of the helmet revealed to her by the skull, Greensleeves used the Stone Brain to strip Towser of his magic. Seeing how the punishment caused Towser to run away, screaming madly, Gull found the solution too drastic and cruel, so he decided to let the other wizards retain their magic, but only for doing good. Greensleeves kept to herself the last secret of the Stone Brain, its ability to give magic to anyone, thinking that a similar power was sure to cause another war for control over it.
